We kickstarted an Ellen MacArthur Foundation network
project	with	Aquafil,	BASF,	CHEP,	Cisco,	and	Flex	to	create
an alternative circular supply chain packaging solution to
replace the existing linear plastic-based shrink/stretch
wrap material used to stabilize and protect products in
transit. The volume of business-related packaging is
significant,	as	are	its	environmental	impacts.	Most	of	the
difficult-to-recycle	non-consumer	packaging	waste	is
comprised of single-use plastic, contributing to the 6.8
million	tons	of	plastic	waste	sent	to	landfill	each	year.
